checks.prompt: Write a Python function that returns the n-th Fibonacci number iteratively. Reply with the code only.
What is 17 * 23? Give the final number on the last line.
In two sentences, explain why the sky is blue.
checks.text: The sky appears blue because sunlight is scattered in all directions by the gases and particles in Earth's atmosphere, and blue light is scattered much more than other colors due to its shorter, smaller wavelength. This phenomenon, known as Rayleigh scattering, means our eyes perceive the dominant scattered light from the sky as blue.
